title: Farpoint
subtitle: A weapon held inside an alien world
summary: Farpoint is Impulse Gear's virtual-reality science-fiction shooter, released for PlayStation VR on 16 May 2017.
body: Farpoint is Impulse Gear's virtual-reality science-fiction shooter, released for PlayStation VR on 16 May 2017. Stranded on a hostile alien planet, the player searches for the missing team and a route home while confronting its dangerous inhabitants. The adventure combines exploration with firefights in which the weapon occupies the player's own space. Looking across the landscape and raising a gun to respond become connected physical actions, giving the familiar premise of surviving an unknown world a particularly direct relationship with the controller.

The PS VR Aim Controller tracks the position and orientation of the held weapon. Raising it towards the face lets the player look through its sights, while leaning and ducking change the view around cover. Reaching towards the back switches weapons through a gesture. A DualShock 4 is also supported. Impulse Gear worked with Sony on the peripheral, making the relationship between a physical grip and its virtual counterpart central to the game rather than an accessory added after the shooting was designed.

The single-player story is joined by online cooperative challenges, where a second player helps confront enemy groups and cover the surrounding space. The team designed those encounters around the combined effectiveness of two armed players, giving cooperation its own pressure. Later updates added further maps and competitive modes. Stephen Cox composed the score. Farpoint served as an early substantial showcase for the Aim Controller, demonstrating how precise tracking and a familiar two-handed shape could make a console shooter's basic act of aiming feel different in virtual reality.
